description: Only constructors that appear in the standings are counted. The average count per constructor is computed over them.

c.request: How many constructor standings records does each constructor have, and how does that compare with the average per constructor? Show the 10 constructors furthest above the average. Give the constructor id, its nationality, its number of standings records, and the difference from the average, largest first. Only constructors that appear in the standings are counted. The average count per constructor is computed over them.
c.sql:
WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.constructorId,
    COUNT(*) as standings_count
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  GROUP BY cs.constructorId
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(standings_count) as avg_count
  FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT 
  c.constructorId,
  c.nationality,
  cc.standings_count,
  cc.standings_count - ac.avg_count as difference_from_average
FROM constructor_counts cc
JOIN constructors c ON cc.constructorId = c.constructorId
CROSS JOIN average_count ac
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

a.request: Considering only constructors that have at least one constructor standings record, count each constructor's standings records. Compare each count with the average count over those constructors. Show the 10 constructors furthest above that average: the constructor id, its `nationality`, its record count, and the difference from the average (unrounded), largest difference first.
a.sql: WITH constructor_counts AS (SELECT constructorId, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY constructorId), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_records FROM constructor_counts), with_difference AS (SELECT cc.constructorId, cc.record_count, ac.avg_records, cc.record_count - ac.avg_records as difference FROM constructor_counts cc CROSS JOIN avg_count ac) SELECT wd.constructorId, c.nationality, wd.record_count, wd.difference FROM with_difference wd JOIN constructors c ON wd.constructorId = c.constructorId ORDER BY wd.difference DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: For constructors appearing in constructorStandings, count their records, calculate the average count among only these constructors, and display the top 10 by (count - average), showing constructor id, nationality, record count, and difference from average, ordered by largest difference first.
d.sql: WITH constructor_counts AS (SELECT cs.constructorId, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM constructorStandings cs GROUP BY cs.constructorId), average_calc AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_count FROM constructor_counts) SELECT cc.constructorId, c.nationality, cc.record_count, cc.record_count - ac.avg_count as difference FROM constructor_counts cc JOIN constructors c ON cc.constructorId = c.constructorId CROSS JOIN average_calc ac ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For each constructor with at least one constructorStandings record, count their total number of such records, calculate the average count across all constructors appearing in standings, identify the 10 constructors furthest above that average, and display their constructor id, nationality, standings record count, and difference from average in descending order of difference.
b.sql: WITH constructor_counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(*) as standings_record_count FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(standings_record_count) as avg_count FROM constructor_counts) SELECT cc.constructorId, cc.nationality, cc.standings_record_count, (cc.standings_record_count - ac.avg_count) as difference_from_average FROM constructor_counts cc, average_count ac WHERE cc.standings_record_count > ac.avg_count ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
b.raw: For each constructor with at least one constructorStandings record, count their total number of such records, calculate the average count across all constructors appearing in standings, identify the 10 constructors furthest above that average, and display their constructor id, nationality, standings record count, and difference from average in descending order of difference.
